messages:
Maya: Quick design sync 32 proposing we standardize on inline validation for the bulk-edit form plus a compact top-of-form error summary for destructive actions. Thinking this reduces scanning time when editors focus on many rows. Thoughts? Jon: Inline for per-field fixes = yes. For bulk submissions we still need a concise top summary that lists affected rows and keeps the primary CTA disabled until fixes are made. Otherwise folks get stuck and DM us. Alex: Agree with Jon. Inline errors should be one-line and actionable (e.g., "Invalid URL"), with a "Show row" anchor for collapsed rows. Required markers: a lone asterisk is ambiguous; we should pair it with an sr-only "required" and aria-required on inputs. Sam: A11y checklist: ensure inline errors are announced by screen readers. Use role="alert" or aria-live="assertive" for the first visible error and move focus to the first invalid field on submit. For bulk submits announce "3 rows have errors" and include a keyboard-focusable list to jump to errors. :accessibility: Aria: Copy note 32 avoid repeating "This field is required" verbatim everywhere. Prefer contextual prompts like "Enter a project name" or "Choose a region" when helpful. About destructive confirms: typed-confirm is useful but heavy for frequent small deletes. Maya: Proposal: soft-delete = modal + undo toast. Typed-confirm reserved for full purges or deletes above a threshold (TBD). For mid-size bulk deletes show a modal with an explicit checkbox "I acknowledge this will be permanently removed" and keep the primary CTA disabled until checked. Alex: Mock snippet for labels & announcement (rough): ```html
3 rows have errors. Use the list below to jump to each error.
``` Jon: :thumbsup: Checkbox compromise makes sense. Also show undo retention time in the modal (eg "undo available for 30s"). Sam: Test cases I'll add: keyboard-only delete flow, SR announce of error summary, focus management after submit, collapsed-row error anchoring. Aria: Copy nits 32 avoid alarmist phrasing like "This action cannot be undone" without context. Prefer "This will permanently remove X items from this workspace. You can restore within 30s via undo." Save typed-confirm for irreversible purges. design-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.company/board/bulk-delete-v2 (frame added). A11y checklist appended to spec doc. Maya: Action items: 1) Alex - update Figma with inline-error variants + top summary pattern; 2) Sam - add accessibility test cases; 3) Aria - copy pass for modals & toast; 4) Jon - pick threshold for typed-confirm and sync with PM. We'll review in design critique on Thurs. Jon: I'll pull analytics and post threshold before Thurs. Alex: I'll add code examples and collapsed-row behavior notes. Sam: I'll slot test cases into the sprint. Maya: Thanks team :heart:
